name: enscribe-monorepo
description: Academic publishing on HTML+CSS+JS, with a shorthand authoring syntax. Workspace root (private); the published packages live under packages/ (enscribe, @enscribejs/cli, @enscribejs/ehtml).
author: Ariel Balter <ariel@arielbalter.com>

comments.overrides: katex is pinned to 0.16.45 to reproduce the pre-consolidation dependency baseline: the headline `enscribe` package and its transitive `mermaid` both depend on katex within a `^0.16` range, and a fresh lockfile floats both to 0.16.47. The interpreter's live-link CDN URL literal pins 0.16.45 (guarded by test/cdn-versions.test.js); this override keeps the rendered output byte-stable across the package consolidation. Lift this override in a dedicated katex-bump maintenance slice that also updates the CDN literal and regenerates fixture snapshots.

scripts.test: npm run check:boundary && npm run docs:check && npm run examples:check && npm run check:routing && npm test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:site: npm run docs:gen && rm -rf site && node packages/cli/bin/enscribe.js build docs-source/index.emd -o site
scripts.build:site-all: npm run build:site && npm run build:site-live
